descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
Position: Senior React Developer 
 Location: Remote (Romania) or Hybrid (offices in Cluj and Iasi)
 Seniority: Senior Level
 Language: English
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior React Developer to join our delivery team. The role focuses on the design, development, and maintenance of modern, scalable web applications using React , TypeScript , Node.js , and modern state management solutions.
 You will contribute to the entire application development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation, integration, testing, and go-live - while working closely with customers, back-end developers, and functional consultants.
 Experience integrating React applications into SAP CAP / SAP BTP environments and knowledge of the Tax domain are considered strong advantages.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Front-end Development 
Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications using React and TypeScript
Work with the latest React capabilities, patterns, and development practices
Apply appropriate state management solutions for complex applications
Build reusable, high-quality UI components and ensure consistency across applications
Ensure application performance, maintainability, and usability
 Full-Stack & Integration 
Work with Node.js as part of modern web application architectures
Design and consume APIs and services for seamless front-end and back-end integration
Collaborate with back-end developers to define efficient integration patterns
Support the integration of React applications into enterprise and SAP-based environments
 SAP Environment 
Integrate or support the integration of React applications with SAP CAP and SAP BTP
Work within or alongside the broader SAP development ecosystem
 Consulting and Customer Collaboration 
Collaborate closely with customers, developers, and functional consultants throughout the project lifecycle
Participate in requirements gathering and technical workshops
Support customers from specification and development through testing and go-live
Act as a trusted technical contact for front-end development topics
 Technical Requirements 
 Must-have 
Several years of professional experience in front-end development, with long-term hands-on expertise in React
Very good knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js
Strong knowledge of modern state management approaches and libraries
Experience designing scalable and maintainable front-end architectures
Good understanding of API-based front-end and back-end integration
Fluent English communication skills
 Nice-to-have 
Familiarity with the SAP development environment and ecosystem
Experience or strong domain knowledge in Tax / Tax-related processes
 Methodology 
Used to collaborating closely with customers, developers, and functional consultants
Proactive and solution-oriented mindset
 Soft Skills 
Strong communication skills, especially in direct customer-facing situations
Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving approach
High level of responsibility, ownership, and team spirit
Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders
 Education 
University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field
